claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: General business claim, not about these specific engines; no photo evidence can confirm or deny a general trading claim.

risks.risk: Engines may not run or may have internal mechanical failure (seized, cracked block, worn bearings)
risks.proof: Video clip of each engine being started and running, or a compression test reading

risks.risk: Unknown make, model, and year compatibility
risks.proof: Close-up photo of engine ID/serial number plate or casting number
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic/unidentified engine, lowest compatibility tier

risks.risk: Incomplete internals (pistons, timing components, turbo, injectors) not visible from exterior shot
risks.proof: Photos of engine block opened or itemized parts list with close-ups
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, assume missing major internals

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, oil/coolant leaks, or rust damage not visible from this angle
risks.proof: Multiple close-up photos from all sides including underside and oil pan

risks.risk: Wiring harness and sensor completeness unknown
risks.proof: Photo showing full length of harness and connector ends, plus ECU if included
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming harness incomplete, no ECU included

risks.proof: Service history, odometer photo from donor vehicle if available, or dealer's declared mileage with supporting document

risks.risk: Reason for removal (accident vs. failure vs. upgrade) affects value
risks.proof: Photo or statement with proof of donor vehicle condition, e.g. accident report or workshop removal record
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming removal due to failure (worst case)

proof_requests: Video of each engine running or being cranked
Close-up photos of engine ID/serial plates for both engines
Photos of full wiring harness length and connector ends
Multiple angle close-ups showing block, oil pan, and head for cracks/leaks
Any documentation on mileage, donor vehicle, or reason for removal
response.reason: The witness confirms these are two used car engines in generic condition with no test or identity data, so they can be priced at worst case (unverified running state, unknown compatibility, possible incompleteness) pending the listed proofs.
